item.title: Black burlesque performers push for more diversity in Toronto
item.description: Toronto's burlesque scene, while thriving, still struggles with diversity.The artform dates back to the mid-19th century, and Black, Asian, and Latinx performers were a huge part of its origins, though their contributions are often overlooked.
